---
title: "bare-metal"
subtitle: "Hand-tuned NVIDIA SASS kernels for RTX 3070 Ti (GA104, sm_86)"
toc: false
---

CUDA and hand-edited SASS kernels for a single, fully characterised GPU — no
cuBLAS, no cuDNN, no PyTorch in the optimised path. Reference libraries are
linked only for measured comparisons.

Everything published here is generated from the repository's own documents.

Read the performance figures with the project's own caveats attached: they come
from one laptop-bin RTX 3070 Ti under a 150 W VBIOS cap, several are `n=1`, and
where the repository disputes one of its own numbers there is an open issue
saying so. The [documentation index](docs/index.md) links the methodology.

## Measurement, honestly

The performance figures come from one laptop-bin RTX 3070 Ti under a 150 W VBIOS
cap, and the project documents its own measurement conditions rather than only
its results: which configs were measured, which were skipped, and what the GPU
was doing at the time. See
[benchmark methodology](docs/benchmark_methodology.md) and the
[roofline analysis](docs/roofline_measured.md).
